body: -- Founder, after multiple 'live reload is still broken' reports and every previous fix targeting the index page: 'LIVE RELOAD STILL BROKEN WTF BRO'. Root cause: grepping render.go for setInterval/insertNewCards before this fix showed exactly ONE hit -- only indexTemplate had a poll script. subjectTemplate and styleTemplate never had one, so rebuilding/restarting iduna.service for the index page's mechanism could never have fixed pages that had nothing to fix. New shared leafPollScript spliced into both templates. Live-verified via curl (correct poll script + data-filter attributes on the real Pinup Girl subject page) and a real Playwright/Chromium browser (zero console/page errors, confirmed working end-to-end on the index page with a real 175->176 card-count change caught live). IDUNA b6b5187.
title: Found and fixed the real live-reload bug: subject/style pages never had polling
